notes.title: Update to version 0.6
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I’ve just released a new update for Beneath the Bell!
After reviewing your feedback and carefully testing the game, I realized that the changes I made to the exploration system (like disabling sprinting and adding overly explicit navigation hints) weren’t working as intended. The result? A less engaging experience.

But don’t worry, I’ve fixed it:
[list]
[*]     Sprinting is back! You can now run freely.
[*]     Revised navigation hints: They’re less intrusive and designed to encourage exploration.
[*]     Improved visuals: More vibrant and detailed colors.
[*]     New "pixelation" effect: Toggle it in-game for a retro vibe.
[*]     New jump scares: Extra frights, including one in the updated demo (version 0.6).
[*]     General improvements for a smoother experience.
[*]     Bug fixes: Addressed several minor issues.
[/list]

Thank you so much for your valuable feedback.
Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Update to version 0.3.
notes.content:
Hi everyone, and Happy New Year! 🥳

I hope 2025 brings you all the best. 

To kick things off, I’ve just released an updated version of the demo for Beneath The Bell! 

Here's what’s new:
[list]
[*] [b]Improved lighting design[/b] to help players navigate the environment more effectively.
[*] [b]Adjusted sprinting mechanics: [/b]sprint has been removed where unnecessary to create a better-paced experience.
[*] [b]Added more spooky elements[/b] for an extra dose of tension.
[*] [b]General improvements[/b] to enhance the overall atmosphere and gameplay.
[*] [b]Bug fixes[/b] to ensure a smoother experience.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333164/edd2780d2f8e30a9ea72ab2c983c80a2bfb5316f.jpg[/img]

[b]Important note:[/b] Previous save files are not compatible with this update. I recommend starting a new game to enjoy all the latest changes.

Thank you for playing and supporting Beneath The Bell!

notes.title: Update to version 0.2
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I’ve just released a new update for the Beneath the Bell demo, and I’d love for you to check it out. 

Here's what's new:
[list]
[*] [b]Revamped the bell classroom puzzle:[/b] Based on your feedback, I’ve redesigned this puzzle to make its solution more intuitive for players.
[*] [b]Fixed a bug with the bouncing basketball:[/b] This issue could block progress, so it’s been addressed.
[*] [b]Minor bug fixes:[/b] Various small improvements have been made to enhance gameplay.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333164/9584e217e3d40a30b0f2f87e1b156e106af5f3dc.jpg[/img]

In addition, I’m focusing on refining the lighting and audio design to better guide players through the level. 

Your feedback is incredibly helpful, so please let me know your thoughts!

Thank you for playing the demo and supporting the development of Beneath the Bell!
